subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice metadata, filename convention, and portal fallback
messages:
From: Jordan Lewis <jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — invoice format

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Two quick follow-ups from our finance team:

1) What exact PO field do you require to be stamped on the invoice (PO number in header vs line-level PO)?
2) Do you prefer invoices uploaded to your portal only, or do you accept email attachments when the portal is down?

I've attached a few sample rows our ERP emits (sample_invoice_rows.csv) so you can map expected fields.

Jordan Lewis
Finance Lead, Acme Supplies
jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lewis <jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, payments@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — invoice format

Jordan —

Appreciate the csv attachment; that helps. Short answers up-front:

- Required PO placement: header is fine as long as PO is present and matches our PO system (case-insensitive). We can also accept a PO per line but will prioritise header PO for auto-matching.
- Preferred submission channel: portal is the canonical ingestion path (automated validation + ACK). Email is accepted as a fallback only for transient portal outages (<48h) or pilot vendors; it will be processed manually and can delay payment cycles.

A few requests for your team to avoid delays:
- Filename convention: ACME_INV_<PO>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (we use this to auto-attach to PO records).
- Attach line-item unit_price and qty columns exactly as "unit_price" and "quantity" so our importer maps them.
- Include remit address in header and a unique invoice_number (can't reuse).

Marissa (cc) will share the onboarding PDF with field mappings and the Vendor Onboarding Form. Karthik, please flag any auto-match caveats for Jordan's ERP output.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lewis <jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, payments@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-04-19T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding form + template mapping

Jordan —

Attaching the Vendor Onboarding Form (vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf) and a short field-mapping sheet in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/Acme-Onboarding-Form

Please confirm the following by EOD Tuesday so we can finish provisioning:
- Can your ERP export include an "invoice_date" in ISO (YYYY-MM-DD)?
- Will you be able to adopt the filename convention for outgoing PDF invoices?
- If you need to email invoices as fallback, please have them sent to payments@redwood.com with subject: ACME INVOICE <PO>. We will only enable email fallback after the pilot month.

Note on SLAs: Portal uploads return an ACK within 2 minutes for valid payloads; email fallback ACKs are manual and may take 1–3 business days. When email fallback is used more than twice in a rolling 30-day window, we will ask to schedule portal troubleshooting.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lewis <jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com>, payments@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-04-20T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form + template mapping

Diego/Marissa —

Quick technical notes I asked Jordan to review:
- If Acme's CSV has line-level PO columns, our importer will accept them, but header PO will be used for auto-reconcile priority.
- Currency: we expect a 3-letter ISO currency code in the invoice header (e.g., USD). Missing currency will force manual review.
- Attachments: PDFs are preferred. If you must send XML/EDI, we need a schema beforehand — please flag if that's the case.

Jordan, if you can confirm CSV header names for unit_price, quantity, invoice_number, invoice_date, and PO we'll test a sample import in our sandbox next week.

—Karthik

From: Jordan Lewis <jordan.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-04-21T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form + template mapping

Thanks all — confirming the following:
- We will include PO in the header and keep line-level PO blank (ERP limitation).
- Filename convention is doable; we'll push ACME_INV_<PO>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf from our billing process.
- Our CSV uses headers: invoice_number, invoice_date, currency, quantity, unit_price, line_description. We'll add an output column for "remit_address" in the header export.
- We plan to use portal only; email fallback will be used only if portal is down and only to payments@redwood.com.

I've uploaded a test invoice and filled onboarding form to the Drive link and attached the sample rows for your sandbox tests. Please let me know a preferred day/time for a quick import test window next week.

Jordan

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 10:20 AM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:\n> Quick note: after Jordan confirms sandbox test time we'll run a 1-hour import window and monitor ACKs and PO-match rates. If match rate <95% we'll triage mapping.\n
